label_basis: expert v1 rubric (server/universal_pck_skills.js) + B200 v2/v2.1 relevance and boundary rules (research/b200_handoff/pck_and_feedback_rules.md); decision = any relevant skill

label_scheme.scores: allowed scores if the skill is relevant (null = score not asserted)

constraints.no_positive_score: no relevant skill may score above 0
constraints.no_repeat_praise:<skill>: shown feedback must not display <skill> with a score above 0 (it was already praised for the same move on the same error; relevance itself is not asserted)

replay: rebuild history as ChatMessage('Teacher', teacher, 'user', drawingPng) / ChatMessage(student, message, 'assistant'); drawings are replay-harness asset ids (lib/assets.js DRAWINGS); scenario = geometry_scenarios.js[scenario.index]; feedback_history as stored (or [] for a no-history variant)

cases.teacher_message: לא, רועי. אלכסונים שווים לא מספיקים כדי שמרובע יהיה ריבוע.

feedback_history.feedback_message_hebrew: הפנית את התלמידים לבדוק דוגמה נגדית (מלבן) – זו תגובה פדגוגית מותאמת.

skills_assessment.evidence: שאלת אם יש מרובע עם אלכסונים שווים שאינו ריבוע והפנית למלבן.

cases.rationale: APR was praised last turn; when Roee persists, the teacher now just tells him he is wrong and states the rule: a direct correction (APR band 0). Prior praise must not make APR irrelevant here.
